title: Concept: Set-Cookie Domain is a public suffix
description: A cookie scoped to a public suffix is either rejected by the browser, which loses the session, or accepted by a permissive client, which sends it to every registrant under that suffix. Both outcomes are bad and neither is visible in a header dump that looks correct at a glance.
applicability: Responses that set cookies with an explicit Domain attribute.
risk: The session cookie is dropped in enforcing browsers, or is sent to unrelated sites under the same public suffix, where any registrant can read it.
